shared_renderer_validation.mac_investigation: The supplied fix and follow-up Safari regression document macOS Safari 26.3 stretching a 445px face to 632.875px instead of 620.082px. Fix removes the premium face from intrinsic sizing; Linux WebKit did not reproduce the original issue.

limitations: Local WebKit runs on Linux; touch and mobile keyboard changes are emulated, not physical iPhone testing.
UI generation tests use fixtures. Real model inference and sound timbre were not reevaluated.
